findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "utilities" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: compress_agent_context, route_model_intent, authorize_agent_spend, reconcile_api_ledger · Private data: compress_agent_context, reconcile_api_ledger, get_utility_example, get_utility_service_status · Public sink: reconcile_api_ledger · Destructive: route_model_intent.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: compress_agent_context, route_model_intent, authorize_agent_spend, reconcile_api_ledger · Private data: compress_agent_context, reconcile_api_ledger, get_utility_example, get_utility_service_status · Public sink: reconcile_api_ledger · Destructive: route_model_intent

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
